column3: NKJV joins verses 2–4 into one sentence (“while Eli was lying down … that the LORD called”).
NKJV moves “in the temple of the LORD” (rendered “tabernacle”) from Samuel’s lying down to the lamp of God, and makes the verse part of the sentence running from verse 2 to verse 4.
Close to the Hebrew; the verse completes the sentence begun in verse 2.
NKJV has “I have told him” for “I tell him,” and renders “were bringing a curse on themselves” as “made themselves vile.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “the Lord” as the subject of “spoke.”
